summary: Verified the 4 requested upgrades end-to-end. Backend: SSE stream endpoint returns start/delta*/done with multiple incremental deltas; uploads endpoint accepts PNG and serves file bytes with correct mime; vision path (chat with image attachment) correctly identifies red+yellow; image-edit path routes to action=image and returns a valid edited image; webapp build then follow-up 'make the header dark blue' routes to webapp again and produces a NEW cid with different HTML (edit-context works). Frontend: /app/chat streams assistant text progressively (observed lengths 0 -> 26 -> 109), attachment preview chip appears after paperclip upload, user bubble renders the image thumbnail (data-testid user-attachment-image), and Regenerate buttons appear under assistant messages and produce a new response when clicked. 5/5 new pytest tests pass; previous test_unified_agent.py still passes.

integration_issues.flow: Regenerate on an assistant reply that was grounded on an attached image
integration_issues.issue: Clicking the Regenerate button under a vision answer re-sends the user's TEXT only — the original attachment is not resent. The new reply says 'I don't see an image attached. Please upload it, and I can identify the colors.' Root cause: pages/Chat.js `regenerate(i)` calls `send(messages[j].content)` without passing the original attachment. The user message stored in state has `media: {type,url,name}` but not the full upload object required by /agent/stream (needs `path` and `mime`), so the attachment info is effectively lost after the first send. Recommendation: store the full Attachment object on the user message (or lookup by url) and pass it to send() when regenerating, so image-grounded/edit prompts can be regenerated properly.

action_items: Chat.js regenerate() must preserve the original user message's attachment. Store the full upload object (path, mime, kind, name, url) on the user message and pass it to send() when regenerating so vision/image-edit prompts can be re-run with the same image.
critical_code_review_comments: Chat.js regenerate() loses attachment context — see integration_issues above.

studio/router.py has two nearly-identical unified agent endpoints (/agent and /agent/stream) with duplicated pre/post logic (insert user msg, load history, fetch attachment, route_intent, persist assistant, update title). Consider extracting a shared helper (`_prepare_agent(sid, body)` -> (att, context, route)) to reduce drift.

chat_agent_stream: on route_intent/fetch_attachment exceptions BEFORE the SSE generator starts, the user message has already been persisted (line ~422) but no assistant message is written — the user message is orphaned. Wrap the top of chat_agent/chat_agent_stream in try/except that writes an error assistant bubble on failure.

gateway.stream_chat forces provider=gemini when there's any attachment, but for non-image files the vision-capable multimodal model is not strictly required for a text-context fold-in (that path already uses describe_media in _run_action for non-chat actions). For plain 'chat' action with file (not image), streaming via the default text model + folded context would be more consistent.
PNG upload endpoint has no MIME allow-list; image_testing.md restricts to jpeg/png/webp — server currently accepts any content_type up to 15MB. Consider validating for image_* mimes and file_* mimes.

SSE done payload embeds full assistant message content; for very long webapp builds (backgrounded) this is fine since content is just the intro reply, but confirm client tolerates missing/partial content on error events.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_stream, TEST_webapp_edit chat sessions and a small 200x120 red+yellow PNG upload in Admin Org. Non-destructive; deletable via UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_streaming_uploads.py (SSE deltas, upload+serve, vision, image-edit, webapp build+edit). Frontend Chat.js data-testids of note: chat-attach-btn, chat-file-input, attachment-preview, attachment-remove, user-attachment-image, regenerate-<i>. Streaming HTTP chunks can arrive fast — the test checks >=3 delta events rather than strict wall-clock span. When testing regenerate with attachments, verify the user's original upload is resent to /agent/stream (currently it's dropped).
rca of the issue: Regenerate-with-image bug: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Chat.js the `send` function accepts (preset, attachArg). `regenerate(i)` passes only messages[j].content, so attachArg is undefined and useAttach falls back to `attachment` state which was cleared after the initial send. The user message in state carries only a partial media object ({type,url,name}) that lacks `path`/`mime`/`kind` required by the /uploads Attachment schema. Fix: keep the full upload response on the user message (e.g. `attachment` field) and, in regenerate, call send(text, storedAttachment).
